title: Убирать данные писем из журналов Temporal без изменения старых контрактов
description: Discovered during bounded dbxe.24. Current unchanged send.email.workflow.ts logs the raw failure; V2 and V3 dropped-mail paths log recipient, subject and raw error message. Installed @temporalio/worker activity.js also forwards raw activity errors to its logger. EmailActivityV2 failure details contain to/subject. Direct EmailService/video console call sites are fixed separately in24; this does not prove queue/runtime stdout privacy. No production prevalence or customer-log contents inspected. Coordinate with existing31 active-queue migration; never rewrite recorded workflow/activity contracts or blindly terminate/resignal live mail.
acceptance_criteria: Synthetic recipient, subject, body, cookie and nested provider-error sentinels absent in stdout/stderr through the installed SDK worker and dropped-mail paths, with safe fixed outcomes and opaque execution correlation. Existing history/replay and retry/non-retryable classification preserved; no lost/duplicated queued mail. Scope logging changes to mail, no global suppression/collector settings or live messages. Existing31 migration and29 exact-source delivery remain explicit.
